blocks.text: Blockchain technology kuch core principles (sab se aham usool) par bani hai jo is ke kaam aur hifazat ko yaqeeni banate hain. Decentralization: aam databases ko ek central authority (ek hi malik jo sab control kare) chalata hai, lekin blockchain ko computers (nodes) ka network mil kar chalata hai jo transactions ki jaanch (validate) aur record karte hain. Is decentralized structure se 'single point of failure' (ek jagah kharabi se poora system ruk jana) ka khatra kam hota hai aur hifazat barhti hai.

items: Immutability (na badalne ki khoobi): ek dafa block blockchain mein jur jaye to use badla ya mitaya nahi ja sakta. Is se transactions ki tareekh (history) permanent aur tamper-proof (chhed chhaar se mehfooz) rehti hai, aur tamam transactions ka reliable aur na badalne wala record ban jata hai.

Consensus Mechanisms (sab ki raaye ek karne ke tareeqe): blockchain networks transactions ke sahi hone par agree karne ke liye consensus mechanisms istemal karte hain. Naya block chain mein jorne se pehle network ke nodes ki kaafi majority (zyada tar log) ka agree karna zaroori hota hai. Aam mechanisms Proof of Work (PoW) aur Proof of Stake (PoS) hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke consensus mechanisms yaqeeni banate hain ke network ke tamam nodes unanimous (sab ki ek hi raaye wala) faisle par pohanchein. Yeh sahi nahi: kaafi majority (aksariyat) ka agree karna kaafi hai, har node ka nahi. Kitab khud 6.4.1 mein likhti hai ke tabdeeli tabhi hoti hai jab majority agree kare. Kuch nodes agree na karein ya band hon tab bhi naya block jur jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar Blockchain network: chhe Blockchain node daire jo sab aapas mein lakeeron se jure hain; do teer neeche Blockchain database ki taraf jate hain. Us mein Block 0, Block n-1 aur Block n har ek mein oopar Timestamp, beech mein Transaction cards ka dher (stack) aur neeche block ka naam hai, aur har block se teer pichhle block ki taraf ishara karta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar ke nodes network ke computers hain; har node ke paas poore record ki copy hoti hai, is liye koi ek center nahi. Neeche database mein blocks ek chain banate hain: har naya block pichhle block se jura hota hai, isi liye teer peeche ki taraf hain. Kisi purane block ko badla jaye to us ke baad ki saari chain ka rishta toot jata hai, jis se tabdeeli pakri jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain mein immutability ka concept (khayal) bataiye; yeh kyun zaroori hai (exercise short question 2)? Immutability ko sab se achhi tarah kaunsa jawab batata hai (exercise MCQ 13)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Data blockchain mein jurne ke baad badla nahi ja sakta. Har block pichhle block ka hash (us ki digital pehchan) rakhta hai aur har node ke paas copy hoti hai, is liye purana record badalne se chain ke rishte toot jate hain aur baqi copies se mel nahi khata. Is se record permanent aur reliable rehta hai, jo paise, contracts, certificates aur supply ke records ke liye zaroori hai.

items: Core principles: decentralization, immutability, consensus mechanisms (PoW, PoS).
Naya block nodes ki kaafi majority ke agree karne se jurta hai (kitab ka 'unanimous' sahi nahi).
